shortdesc.ph: Occurs when the SDK is ready to send metadata.

section.p: As of v4.7.1, this callback can provide metadata for locally transcoded video. When sourceType is AgoraVideoSourceTypeTransCoded, return the metadata to send with the transcoded video stream.
The metadata is carried by the mixed output stream. Metadata from input camera or screen-sharing streams is not automatically merged into the output stream.
section.note: Make sure the size of the metadata does not exceed the value returned by metadataMaxSize, up to 1024 bytes. If the metadata size exceeds this value, the SDK truncates the excess data.

section.title: Trigger Timing
section.p: Triggered when the SDK is ready to send metadata.

plentry.pd: The video source type. As of v4.7.1, AgoraVideoSourceTypeTransCoded identifies the locally transcoded output stream.

section.title: Return Values
section.p: The metadata to send, as NSData. Return nil when there is no metadata to send.
